notes: Measured with the container runtime (Colima) running, which a real-application pair requires; the chaos grid's timings were taken with it stopped.
The 1.22.6 labels were written before Mendwork ran on that release, and approved on 2026-09-16 by Darshan Potnis (repository owner) against the 9 screenshots of the labels walk.
The task's last step creates an issue, which cannot be undone. Its recorded risk was raised to irreversible, so a heal there stops for a person instead of acting.

systems.label: Recorded CSS selector (plain Playwright script)
systems.description: Each step's recorded css selector through page.locator, with Playwright's auto-waiting and strict mode, and nothing else: no identity check, no healing. It is verified by the workflow's own checkpoints, which a plain script usually lacks, so it stops after a caught wrong action where an unasserted script would carry on: its wrong actions are a lower bound.

systems.label: Role + name locator (careful Playwright script)
systems.description: Each step's recorded role and accessible name through Playwright's user-facing locators, or its label for a field without a role, with auto-waiting and strict mode and no healing. It is verified by the workflow's own checkpoints, which a plain script usually lacks, so it stops after a caught wrong action where an unasserted script would carry on: its wrong actions are a lower bound.

systems.label: Mendwork, free rungs only
systems.description: The product as shipped, with no model configured: recorded selectors, alternate selectors, and similarity scoring, every heal verified.

systems.label: Mendwork + ground-truth chooser (upper bound, not a model)
systems.description: The full ladder with Rung 3 answered from the portal's ground truth, only when exactly one listed line reads like the real target: what the rules let a perfect chooser heal. It is not a model, and its numbers are an upper bound.

sections.title: Gitea: recorded on 1.19.4, replayed on 1.22.6
sections.description: A workflow recorded on gitea 1.19.4 and replayed on 1.22.6, each our own container pinned by digest. What counts as correct is a person's label for every acting step of 1.22.6, written from that release's own pages before Mendwork ran on it, approved against the screenshots of a walk that performed the task with the labels alone, and frozen by the labels' digest. Every system gets a freshly seeded instance, because the task ends by creating an issue.
